run_train_pixart_controlnet: run the PixArt ControlNet fine-tuning script with pretrained model, dataset, and validation prompts via argparse CLI
parse_training_arguments: parse argparse CLI arguments for PixArt ControlNet training including dataset paths, batch size, learning rate, and validation settings
log_validation_images: log validation images generated by the PixArt ControlNet pipeline to tensorboard or wandb during training
save_model_card_hub: save a model card README with example images and push the trained ControlNet checkpoint to the Hugging Face Hub
initialize_controlnet_weights: initialize PixArt ControlNet adapter weights from the pretrained transformer or load existing ControlNet weights from a path
